title: Stocks Fall as 30-Year Bond Yields Surge After Fed: Markets Wrap
summary: Stocks ended sharply lower as concerns about inflation drove longer-dated bond yields to an almost two-decade high after the Federal Reserve left rates steady despite a resurgence in oil prices.

title: Earnings Reflect Changing Consumer Priorities
summary: Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Despite being less than halfway through earnings seasons, and with retailers yet to report, many consumer-facing companies have announced results that make it clear inflation is changing spending patterns. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Warsh Says Fed Won't Be Constrained by Market Prices
summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh says markets can be a good source of information but not a determinative or perfect source during a news conference following the central bank's decision to leave rates unchanged. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Dollar Sinks Most in Two Weeks After Fed Holds Rates Steady
summary: The dollar fell the most in two weeks after the Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged, and as traders pared bets that the central bank will boost borrowing costs at its next meeting in September.

title: Jersey Mike’s Set To Make Trading Debut Thursday
summary: Bloomberg's Ryan Gould joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Jersey Mike’s Subs’s initial public offering has attracted investor demand for more than 10 times the available shares ahead of pricing on Wednesday, according to people familiar with the matter. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Koch Said to Mull $15B Sale of Edged
summary: Bloomberg's Allison McNeely joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Koch is exploring a sale of Edged, the data center developer it cofounded to build projects for the biggest hyperscalers, according to people with knowledge of the matter. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nasdaq 100 Enters Correction, S&P 500 Falls After Fed Decision
summary: The Nasdaq 100 Index closed in correction territory, pushing the broader stock market lower as the Federal Reserve refrained from raising interest rates but a trio of dissents signaled support for tighter monetary policy.

title: Warner Bros. Deal Collapse Would Cost the Ellisons $9.8B
summary: Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." Larry Ellison and his family would be on the hook for $9.8 billion if Paramount Skydance's deal to buy Warner Bros. Discovery Inc. falls apart. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: US Says Ex-Goldman Banker Berko Paid a ‘Holy Rain’ of Bribes
summary: A former Goldman Sachs Group Inc. banker went on trial for allegedly bribing government officials in Ghana to secure a lucrative power plant deal for a client.

title: Paramount ‘Highly Confident’ In Warner Bros. Deal
summary: Bloomberg's Hannah Miller joins Dani Burger on "Bloomberg Deals." A federal judge temporarily paused Paramount Skydance’s $110 billion takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery  saying it “likely” violates antitrust law. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for July 29

title: World Cup's Busiest Host City Savors a Big Victory

title: Private Credit Has an Affiliation Problem
summary: A potential slowdown in the private credit-insurance pipeline.

title: USMCA Critical 'Competitiveness Platform' to Compete with China, Says John Bozzella
summary:
John Bozzella, president and CEO of Alliance for Automotive innovation, said that it is critical to have a trilateral trade agreement between the US, Canada and Mexico as a 'competitiveness platform' to compete with China in the automotive industry. Bozzella also discussed legislation to bar Chinese autos, saying that popular car company Mercedes would have to seek a waiver due to Chinese ownership stake. 
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed Should've Raised Rates Amid 'Hot' Inflation, Economist Swonk Says
summary: KPMG Chief Economist Diane Swonk says she expects a rate hike in September after the decision by the Federal Reserve's policy-setting Federal Open Market Committee to leave rates unchanged. She speaks on Bloomberg Television's "The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Emerging-Market Currencies Edge Up After Fed Holds Rates Steady
summary: Emerging-market currencies gained after the Federal Reserve held interest rates steady, pushing the US dollar lower as traders priced out the remaining odds of an immediate rate increase.

title: Ex-French Fighter Pilot Charged in China Spying Case, AFP Says
summary: A former French fighter pilot was charged and placed under judicial supervision for allegedly collecting and providing classified information to a foreign power, AFP reported, citing the Paris public prosecutor’s office.

title: Jim Leaviss, Renowned British Bond Investor, Dies at 55
summary: Jim Leaviss, the former head of fixed income at M&G Investments and creator of the popular Bond Vigilantes blog, has died. He was 55.

title: Gold Advances After Fed Leaves Interest Rates Unchanged
summary: Gold advanced after the Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged while repeating the central bank’s pledge to “deliver price stability.”
